method: Human-visible image inspection after native rendering and a pixel comparison of every view with revision 16. Hashes pin the reviewed images.

comparison_with_revision_16.exploded: 263 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (soft-shadow sampling regions)
comparison_with_revision_16.control_side: 635 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (soft-shadow sampling regions)
comparison_with_revision_16.io_terminals_detail: 15,429 of 1,350,000 pixels differ by more than 24: the thinner SDS-50J pins and narrower PJ-202AH terminal 2

observations: Alpha and Panasonic bracket tabs now pass through green drill rings at the slot centres.
PJ-202AH terminal 2 now fits its ring; terminal 3 stays red (0.04 mm, Eagle position).
SDS-50J pins are visibly thinner; pins 1 and 2 stay red at the Eagle grid positions, pins 3-5 and both earth legs are green.
NYS216 and the USB board locks are unchanged and remain red as recorded.
The assembled case, rear panel and legends are unchanged.
limitations: Image inspection supplements the geometric audits; it does not measure clearance.
Images do not qualify physical assembly fit.
